journey.observation: With VoiceOver and its Caption Panel running, Safari exposed the page title as ‘Trusted government knowledge discovery’. The retained frame shows the visible ‘Government evidence for your AI’ service heading and the Caption Panel identifying ‘Evidence answer’ as the page's level-one heading.
journey.limitation: The first frame used accessibility focus rather than retaining the VoiceOver rotor itself; later frames retain native VoiceOver heading and link navigation in the Caption Panel.

journey.observation: Safari and VoiceOver identified ‘Skip to main content’ as a link. Activating it moved accessibility focus to the main content container and the Caption Panel identified the main region.

The persistent Evidence answer and Technical review navigation remained available. Activating Technical review selected that view, moved to its single level-one heading and made the Caption Panel identify ‘Technical review: government knowledge evidence’ as a level-one heading.

A bounded ‘housing’ search used the four federated collections, excluded reviewed deep evidence and retained the eight-result limit. Activating ‘Show evidence for this result’ for record ‘govuk-discovery:federated:land-registry:57845’ updated the page's Evidence answer and focused its level-one heading.

Native VoiceOver heading navigation reached ‘Integrity, access, rights and coverage’. The retained frame shows the complete Caption Panel announcement and the separate integrity, access, rights and coverage values.

The Evidence answer retained the descriptively named ‘Open recorded source link’, source role ‘Recorded source link declared by the producer’, source authority ‘Not independently established’, publisher ‘HM Land Registry’ and destination ‘www.gov.uk’. The link was not opened.

Native VoiceOver heading navigation reached ‘Compare this with your AI's answer’. The retained frame shows the complete Caption Panel announcement and all three ‘From this page’, ‘From your AI’ and ‘Check carefully’ columns.

Activating the persistent Technical review navigation returned to the detailed interface without losing the Evidence answer selection. Safari exposed the populated ‘housing’ search field, Search button, expanded filters, four selected federated collections, unselected reviewed collection and eight-result limit.

Activating ‘View record and provenance’ opened the exact Land Registry record. Closing it restored accessibility focus to its originating ‘View record and provenance’ button; the retained frame and final accessibility-tree check both identify that control. Immediately after this ninth checkpoint, the Caption Panel and VoiceOver were turned off and verified off.

limitations: The first frame used accessibility focus rather than retaining the VoiceOver rotor itself; later frames retain native VoiceOver heading and link navigation in the Caption Panel.
VoiceOver speech audio was not captured; the retained sequence uses the Caption Panel and manual Safari accessibility observations.
This screenshot sequence is not a continuous recording.
This observation covers one manual environment and does not establish WCAG conformance.

The capture did not retain independent deployment metadata before and after the manual journey; the commit and Pages run identify the intended candidate rather than a cryptographic capture-time binding.
